commit.message:
chore(bump): mathlib 8000f01d29bc → ba2e6f0c7073 (2026-10-28), toolchain v4.36.0-rc1 → v4.36.0-rc2 (#8621)

77 upstream commits, including the toolchain bump to v4.36.0-rc2 (mathlib #45383).
8 files needed mechanical repair; no statement changes, no new sorries.

- mathlib #43848 (Nat recursor arguments renamed): `Nat.strong_induction_on`
  alternative `h` → `ind`, `Nat.case_strong_induction_on` alternatives
  `hz`/`hi` → `zero`/`succ`, and its named argument `(p := …)` → `(motive := …)`
  (ArtinHasseExpEqZetaPow, PowerBasisInjective, DieudonneDworkCriterion,
  RIntegralPredicate, LinearKneser, AffineVanishing).
- mathlib #45255 (absNorm lemmas now assume `Ring.HasFiniteQuotients`):
  `ZetaProduct.two_le_absNorm` gets a local
  `have : Ring.HasFiniteQuotients R := .of_module_finite ℤ R`, the idiom mathlib uses.
- mathlib #45320 (`ValuativeExtension.vle_iff_vle` arguments now implicit):
  `⟨fun _ _ => Iff.rfl⟩` → `⟨Iff.rfl⟩` and positional `s 0` → `(a := s) (b := 0)`
  (WedhornValueGroupLocalizationStrictMono).

Full-coverage gate: all 2799 modules built except the known #8574 closure
(OrdPipeline and InvertibleSheafGlueEffectivity still hit kernel deterministic timeouts).
Code-only sorry/admit/native_decide: 256/0/10 before and after.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
